summary: Monitors selected keyboard keys and outputs single-frame channels representing current key state, with modifier and panel-focus filtering.
key_concepts: Receives ASCII keyboard input and outputs a single-frame channel for each monitored key.
The Keys list controls which key channels are created; it does not output every key automatically.
Modifier Keys can ignore modifiers or require exact Ctrl, Alt, Shift, and combined modifier states.
Channel Names can be generated from key names or from channel order numbers.
Panels restrict capture to keyboard events that occur while specific Panel COMPs have focus.
For every keystroke callback behavior, the official docs recommend a Panel Execute DAT watching the panel key value.

common_gotchas: Keyboard In CHOP outputs current key state, not rapid repeated keypress events.
It does not output all keys automatically; keys must be selected.
For every keystroke event, official docs recommend Panel Execute DAT watching the panel key value.
Panel focus filtering is important in multi-panel UIs so global keyboard state does not leak into controls.
While Playing captures events only when the timeline is playing forward.
